# Ageis

> AEGIS — Agentic Engineering: Governance, Implementation & Scaling — a practical guide to running software delivery end to end when agentic coding tools do a meaningful share of the writing. Implements the OASIS methodology's Chapter 14, Intelligence and Agent Engineering, scoped to agentic coding delivery; works standalone otherwise.

Start with [docs/00-overview.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/Agentic-Engineeering-SDLC/main/docs/00-overview.md) — the one detailed walkthrough of the whole repo.

## Core docs

- [Overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/Agentic-Engineeering-SDLC/main/docs/00-overview.md): the full mental model in one read.
- [Principles](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/Agentic-Engineeering-SDLC/main/docs/01-principles.md): the five rules everything else derives from.
- [Git Workflow and Automation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/Agentic-Engineeering-SDLC/main/docs/00-git-workflow-and-automation.md): branch/PR/merge flow and what's automatable.
- [Patch vs. Regenerate](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/Agentic-Engineeering-SDLC/main/docs/02-patch-vs-regenerate.md): the other axis of every change.
- [Governance and Risk Tiers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/Agentic-Engineeering-SDLC/main/docs/04-governance-risk-tiers.md): how much autonomy an action gets.
- [Effort-Savings Evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/Agentic-Engineeering-SDLC/main/docs/05-effort-savings-evidence.md): what the data actually shows, including the METR RCT finding.
- [Metrics](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/Agentic-Engineeering-SDLC/main/docs/06-metrics.md): tool-adoption metrics vs. standard SDLC metrics.
- [Tools Comparison](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/Agentic-Engineeering-SDLC/main/docs/07-tools-comparison.md): deployment models and current tool landscape.
- [Agile Workflow](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/Agentic-Engineeering-SDLC/main/docs/08-agile-workflow.md): requirements, architecture, backlog and feature slicing.
- [Related Frameworks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/Agentic-Engineeering-SDLC/main/docs/09-related-frameworks.md): comparison with BMAD, AI-DLC, specs.md and OASIS.

## SDLC phases and practices

- [Phases Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/Agentic-Engineeering-SDLC/main/docs/03-phases/README.md): requirements through production support, one page per phase.
- [Practices Index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/Agentic-Engineeering-SDLC/main/docs/practices/README.md): eleven deep-dive practices, grouped by when each matters.
- [Worked Examples](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/Agentic-Engineeering-SDLC/main/examples/README.md): one feature followed through every phase.
- [Templates](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/Agentic-Engineeering-SDLC/main/templates/README.md): spec, ADR and risk-tier-checklist templates.
- [Domain Mapping](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/Agentic-Engineeering-SDLC/main/domains/domains.md): 40 engineering domains mapped to agentic-engineering practice.
